results.title: ENHYPEN [WALK THE LINE SUMMER EDITION] IN CINEMAS
results.original_title: 엔하이픈 [워크 더 라인 썸머 에디션] 인 시네마
results.overview: Experience ENHYPEN WORLD TOUR 'WALK THE LINE' IN JAPAN – SUMMER EDITION on the big screen! From their very first meeting to the global stage they command today, ENHYPEN's journey is one of growth, unity, and connection. Rising to million-seller status within a year, achieving a record-breaking Tokyo Dome debut, earning their first grand prize in 2025, and delivering a headline-making performance at Coachella, the group's success has been shaped by the powerful bond they share with ENGENEs. This concert film captures that bond in full: electrifying live performances, the intensity of rehearsals, candid moments behind the scenes, and the everyday lives of the members as they travel through Japan in the heat of summer. More than a concert, it is a celebration of connection, a line that continues to extend forward, carrying ENHYPEN and ENGENEs toward the future, together.

results.title: Broken English
results.overview: A survivor, provocateur and true original, Marianne has spent more than six decades defying expectations — releasing over thirty-five albums while constantly reinventing herself. Made with her full involvement, Broken English is an intimate and unflinching exploration of a fractured yet unbreakable life shaped by fame, creativity and relentless public scrutiny.

results.title: Zaz - Sounds Like Art  @ Mo Museum, Vilnius
results.original_title: Zaz - Sounds Like Art - MO Museum, Vilnius
results.overview: With her husky voice, Zaz captivated the international stage in 2010 with her song “Je veux.” More than fifteen years later, she is performing at the MO Museum in Vilnius, surrounded by works by young contemporary artists such as Selma Selman, Vytautas Viržbickas, Andrius Arutiunian, and the group Baltos Kandys. The singer will perform songs from her latest album, “Sains et saufs.”

results.title: Silkscreen
results.overview: A struggling shirt printer reconnects with his aging father, the former owner of their now-fading family business, as they confront the changes time has brought to their craft and relationship.

results.title: Death Came Knocking
results.overview: In the summer of 1978, two cousins are trapped inside their childhood home by a group of strangers. As the night continues, survival slowly turns to murder.

results.title: Pale Night
results.overview: In the 1930s, the solitary lives of an ether addicted doctor and a lonely housekeeper are disrupted by the sudden arrival of a Bible salesman and his troubled sister. Repressed secrets and desires surface, leading to disturbing consequences.

results.title: No Sunshine in Here
results.overview: Karoline, a filmmaker and the daughter of a domestic worker, embarks on a journey across Brazil to investigate the relationship between the slave quarters and the maid's room.

results.title: The Botanist
results.overview: Set in a remote village in Xinjiang, China, a young Kazakh boy named Arsin, who finds solace in the company of plants, meets Meiyu, a spirited Han girl whose unpredictable nature reminds him of a rare, otherworldly plant. As their friendship blossoms, it deepens into a delicate, dreamlike allegory that blurs the lines between reality and the enchanting world of botany.

results.title: Unauthorised Absence
results.overview: A single mother fighting for support for her autistic daughter is fined, threatened and pushed to breaking point by an education system that wasn’t built for them.

results.title: Future Tense
results.overview: Cape Town, South Africa. In a near future on the brink of climate collapse, Lwando and his girlfriend Tara are among the privileged few who win the opportunity to travel back to 1647 and a pre-colonial past to experience nature in its wildest form. Lwando is an underground activist who dreams of changing the course of history. Tara wants to save her relationship with him. Together, the couple must choose whether to risk life as they know it for a potentially better world.

results.title: Field Queens
results.overview: In rural Ireland, two fifteen-year-old girls clean vomit from a minibus after a drunken mishap the previous night. When they encounter the bus driver's elderly wife and spend the day with her drinking in a field, their friendship is put to the test unexpectedly.

results.title: Un mal partido
results.overview: An overprotective father clashes with his daughter's boyfriend during a family trip, leading to comedic tension as he struggles to accept their relationship while trying to maintain control.
